one_line: A Kadamba-era dharmamaharaja from Banavasi, embodying both Shaiva temple kingship and generous Jain patronage, c. 5th century CE.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic but not bulky, upright regal posture
appearance.face: oval face with sharp jawline, medium brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm focused eyes with slightly arched brows, default expression a composed, dignified half-smile suggesting measured authority and tolerance
appearance.hair: thick black hair gathered into a high knotted bun at the back of the crown, smoothed at the front with a central part; a simple gold band-circlet rests low on the forehead, decorated with a small leaf-shaped central ornament
appearance.costume: He wears an early Deccan royal outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton angavastra-style upper cloth wrapped diagonally over the left shoulder and across the torso, leaving both shoulders covered and draping smoothly down the back, paired with a deep red silk dhoti wrapped tightly and falling to the ankles in clean pleats, bordered with a narrow gold stripe; around his waist is a broad gold cloth belt with a subtle woven pattern of small repeating floral motifs; his chest and shoulders are modestly covered by the upper cloth but over it sit two slim gold chest-bands crossing near the sternum; he wears a long mango-leaf motif gold necklace, shorter beaded necklaces, medium-sized circular gold earrings, simple gold armlets on both upper arms, and slim stacked bangles at the wrists; his feet are in plain dark brown leather sandals; a light yellow sash falls from his belt on the left side, hinting at courtly elegance without excess ornamentation, evoking 5th-century Karnataka aesthetics.
appearance.signature: A polished copper land-grant plate bundle tied with a red cord and hung from his left hand, with a slender stylus tucked into his belt, representing royal charters to Shaiva temples and Jain institutions.

ref_desc: A medium-brown, oval-faced Kadamba king in his mid-30s with a high black hair bun and gold circlet, off-white angavastra, deep red ankle-length dhoti with gold border, gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a copper land-grant plate bundle with red cord and stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Kadamba-era dharmamaharaja from 5th-century Banavasi: a medium-brown, oval-faced man in his mid-30s with sharp jawline, calm focused eyes, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, thick black hair gathered into a high knotted bun, and a simple gold band-circlet on his forehead with a small leaf-shaped central ornament. He wears an off-white cotton angavastra-style upper cloth wrapped diagonally over his left shoulder and across the torso, covering both shoulders and draping down his back, and a deep red silk dhoti wrapped neatly to the ankles with clean pleats and a narrow gold border. Around his waist is a broad gold cloth belt with a subtle repeating floral pattern, from which a light yellow sash hangs on the left; two slim gold chest-bands lie over the upper cloth. Show layered jewellery: a long mango-leaf motif gold necklace, a shorter beaded gold necklace, circular gold earrings, simple gold armlets on both upper arms, and slim stacked bangles at his wrists. His feet are in plain dark brown leather sandals. In his left hand he holds a polished copper land-grant plate bundle tied with a red cord, while a slender stylus is tucked into his belt, symbolizing royal charters to Shaiva temples and Jain institutions. Use a palette of off-white, deep red, gold, medium brown skin tones, and light yellow accents, and present him from multiple angles in a dignified, composed stance suitable for consistent redrawing.
